video.title: Does a Visible Savings Goal Help?

elements.content: A visible savings goal may help you save more.
You mean to save, but the money sits in one pile with no name,
A 2011 study of low-income consumers tested saving with a named goal.
A visual reminder of the goal raised the savings rate,
and splitting the money into two parts helped too.
A practical way to try this.
One: name one goal, like a trip or a laptop.
Two: keep a visible reminder of it, like a jar or a photo.
Three: split the saving into two separate parts.
This was one study of low-income consumers, so results may differ for you.
Try it today: name one savings goal, and put it where you can see it.
